eyebrow: Upward Sports at Christ Community Church
heading: Every kid gets in the game.
text: Soccer, flag football, and cheer for Omaha kids from kindergarten through high school. Every player gets real time on the field, coaches who care, and a league built on Christian character. It's affordable, it's low pressure, and it fits a busy family's week.
photoAlt: A young Upward soccer player smiling as he runs through a tunnel of cheering parents

soccerCard.label: Soccer
soccerCard.text: Ages 5 through 12th grade. Saturday games, one weeknight practice.

footballCard.label: Flag Football & Cheer
footballCard.text: Kindergarten through high school. Saturday games all fall.
